title: Significant UK Environmental Law Cases 2024–25
content:
Abstract
This case law overview comments on significant UK environmental law cases for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025. It begins with an overarching introduction that draws some general themes from our selection of cases and considers potential changes to EU-derived regimes following Brexit. It then addresses 12 significant cases concerning climate change, habitats, nuisance, trespass, flooding, enforcement by Natural England and the Environment Agency, the Environmental Principles Policy Statement and adequate alternative remedies. It ends with some final thoughts on this year’s cases and the year ahead.
